title: Limit concurrent management sessions to an organization-defined number
check_summary: Management lines must cap the number of simultaneous administrative sessions at the organization-defined value.
fix_summary: Configure the vty/management lines so only the defined maximum number of sessions can be open at once.
config_evidence: line vty ... (session limit / number of vty lines configured)

title: Enforce 3 failed logons then 15-minute lockout
check_summary: The running config must throttle repeated failed logins: three failures within the window triggers a 15-minute block.
fix_summary: Add a login block-for statement of 900 seconds, 3 attempts, within 120 seconds.
config_evidence: login block-for 900 attempts 3 within 120

title: Display DoD notice and consent banner
check_summary: A login banner containing the standard DoD notice and consent text must be present.
fix_summary: Define the banner login with the approved USG notice text.
config_evidence: banner login ^C ... ^C

title: Audit all administrator activity
check_summary: Configuration-change logging must be enabled so admin actions are recorded to syslog.
fix_summary: Enable logging userinfo and the archive log config block with syslog notification and hidekeys.
config_evidence: logging userinfo; archive / log config / logging enable / hidekeys / notify syslog contenttype plaintext

title: Prohibit unnecessary and nonsecure functions and services
check_summary: None of the insecure/legacy services (HTTP server, finger, PAD, small servers, bootp, call-home, etc.) may appear in the config.
fix_summary: Remove each offending service with its no form, notably no ip http server.
config_evidence: absence of: ip http server, service pad, service finger, service tcp-small-servers, service udp-small-servers, ip bootp server, ip finger, service config, service call-home, boot network

title: Only one local account of last resort
check_summary: Exactly one local account may exist, tied to the password policy, with AAA login using the remote server first and local as fallback.
fix_summary: Keep a single local username bound to the common-criteria policy and set aaa authentication login default group tacacs+ local.
config_evidence: username ... privilege ... common-criteria-policy ...; aaa authentication login default group tacacs+ local

title: Minimum 15-character password length
check_summary: The common-criteria password policy must set a minimum length of 15.
fix_summary: Enable aaa new-model and a common-criteria policy with min-length 15.
config_evidence: aaa common-criteria policy PASSWORD_POLICY / min-length 15

title: Store only cryptographic representations of passwords
check_summary: Password encryption must be on and the privileged password must be a hashed enable secret rather than a plain enable password.
fix_summary: Turn on service password-encryption and set an enable secret.
config_evidence: service password-encryption; enable secret 5|8|9 ...

title: Terminate idle management connections after 5 minutes
check_summary: Console, vty and HTTP management sessions must time out after at most five minutes of inactivity.
fix_summary: Set exec-timeout 5 0 on console and vty lines and an ip http timeout-policy idle of 300 seconds.
config_evidence: line con 0 / exec-timeout 5 0; line vty ... / exec-timeout 5 0; ip http timeout-policy idle 300 ...

title: Allocate audit record storage capacity
check_summary: A local logging buffer must be allocated at informational level to hold audit records.
fix_summary: Configure logging buffered with a size and informational severity.
config_evidence: logging buffered <size> informational

title: Alert on audit failure events
check_summary: Syslog trap level must be set so critical audit failure events are sent out.
fix_summary: Set logging trap critical.
config_evidence: logging trap critical

title: Synchronize clock with redundant authoritative time sources
check_summary: At least two NTP servers must be configured.
fix_summary: Add two ntp server entries.
config_evidence: ntp server x.x.x.x (two or more)

title: Authenticate SNMP messages with FIPS-validated HMAC
check_summary: SNMP must be SNMPv3 with at least auth security level using SHA.
fix_summary: Define a v3 group with auth, a v3 user with SHA, and point the host at version 3.
config_evidence: snmp-server group ... v3 auth ...; snmp-server user ... v3 auth sha ...; snmp-server host ... version 3 auth ...

title: Encrypt SNMP messages with FIPS-approved algorithm
check_summary: SNMPv3 must use the priv level with AES encryption.
fix_summary: Define a v3 priv group and a user with auth sha and priv aes 256.
config_evidence: snmp-server group ... v3 priv; snmp-server user ... v3 auth sha ... priv aes 256 ...

title: Cryptographically authenticate NTP sources
check_summary: NTP authentication must be enabled with a keyed trusted source for each server.
fix_summary: Enable ntp authenticate, define an HMAC-SHA2-256 key, trust it, and bind servers to the key.
config_evidence: ntp authenticate; ntp authentication-key 1 hmac-sha2-256 ...; ntp trusted-key 1; ntp server ... key 1

title: FIPS-validated HMAC for remote maintenance session integrity
check_summary: SSH must be version 2 and restrict MAC algorithms to HMAC-SHA2.
fix_summary: Set ip ssh version 2 and limit the server MAC list to hmac-sha2-512 and hmac-sha2-256.
config_evidence: ip ssh version 2; ip ssh server algorithm mac hmac-sha2-512 hmac-sha2-256

title: Cryptographic protection of remote maintenance session confidentiality
check_summary: SSH must be version 2 and restricted to AES-CTR encryption.
fix_summary: Set ip ssh version 2 and limit the server encryption list to aes256/192/128-ctr.
config_evidence: ip ssh version 2; ip ssh server algorithm encryption aes256-ctr aes192-ctr aes128-ctr

title: Log successful and unsuccessful logon attempts
check_summary: Both successful and failed login events must be logged.
fix_summary: Enable login on-failure log and login on-success log.
config_evidence: login on-failure log; login on-success log

title: Use at least two authentication servers
check_summary: AAA must be enabled with a server group containing two or more RADIUS/TACACS servers used for console, vty and HTTP login, with local as fallback.
fix_summary: Enable aaa new-model, define a server group with two servers, and apply the authentication lists to console, vty and ip http.
config_evidence: aaa new-model; aaa group server radius ... (2 servers); aaa authentication login ... group ... local; login authentication on lines

title: Send logs to at least two central log servers
check_summary: At least two remote syslog hosts must be configured.
fix_summary: Add two logging host entries.
config_evidence: logging host x.x.x.x (two or more)

title: BPDU Guard on user-facing access ports
check_summary: Access ports facing users must have BPDU guard enabled, per interface or globally with portfast.
fix_summary: Enable spanning-tree bpduguard on those interfaces or portfast bpduguard default globally.
config_evidence: spanning-tree bpduguard enable (interface); spanning-tree portfast bpduguard default (global)

title: DHCP snooping on all user VLANs
check_summary: DHCP snooping must be enabled globally and for the user VLAN list.
fix_summary: Enable ip dhcp snooping and ip dhcp snooping vlan for user VLANs.
config_evidence: ip dhcp snooping; ip dhcp snooping vlan <list>

title: Unused disabled ports assigned to an inactive VLAN
check_summary: Unused ports must be shut down and placed in an unused VLAN that is not trunked anywhere.
fix_summary: Assign unused ports to a dedicated VLAN (e.g. 999), shut them down, and exclude that VLAN from trunks.
config_evidence: interface ... / switchport access vlan 999 / shutdown; switchport trunk allowed vlan except 999

title: Prune default VLAN 1 from trunks that do not need it
check_summary: VLAN 1 must not appear in the allowed list of trunks.
fix_summary: Use switchport trunk allowed vlan except 1 on trunk interfaces.
config_evidence: switchport trunk allowed vlan except 1 (or explicit list without 1)

title: Native VLAN set to an ID other than VLAN 1
check_summary: Trunk ports must use a non-default native VLAN.
fix_summary: Set switchport trunk native vlan to a non-1 ID matching on both ends.
config_evidence: switchport trunk native vlan <id != 1>

title: Disable inactive interfaces
check_summary: Interfaces not in use must be administratively down.
fix_summary: Apply shutdown to unused interfaces.
config_evidence: shutdown under unused interface stanzas

title: IP directed broadcast disabled
check_summary: Interfaces must not forward IP directed broadcasts.
fix_summary: Use no ip directed-broadcast on interfaces.
config_evidence: absence of ip directed-broadcast on interfaces

title: ICMP redirects disabled on external interfaces
check_summary: External interfaces must not send ICMP redirects.
fix_summary: Apply no ip redirects on external interfaces.
config_evidence: no ip redirects under external interfaces

title: Inbound ACL on external interfaces
check_summary: External interfaces must have an inbound access list applied.
fix_summary: Apply an inbound ACL with ip access-group ... in on each external interface.
config_evidence: ip access-group <acl> in under external interfaces

title: Proxy ARP disabled on external interfaces
check_summary: External interfaces must have proxy ARP turned off.
fix_summary: Apply no ip proxy-arp on external interfaces.
config_evidence: no ip proxy-arp under external interfaces
